scripts.db:migrate: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T api pnpm run db:migrate
scripts.db:generate: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml exec api pnpm run db:generate
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T api pnpm run db:reset && bash scripts/seed-database.sh

auditConfig.//: Two classes of advisory. (1) NO override needed — brace-expansion / fast-uri / js-yaml / nanoid / form-data / qs / vite / rollup: every parent already declares a semver range that admits the patched release, so a lockfile refresh resolves them naturally; carrying an override only papers over a stale lockfile. (rollup's only vulnerable source was @sentry/nextjs@8; the v10 upgrade dropped rollup from the Sentry chain, so its override is gone.) (2) Overrides below ARE load-bearing — the parent pins/caps the transitive BELOW its patch, so a refresh can't reach it: @fastify/swagger-ui pins @fastify/static, drizzle-kit's @esbuild-kit pins esbuild, next pins postcss (~8.4.x) and sharp, node-cron pins uuid@8, tailwindcss@3 caps postcss-selector-parser at ^6 (GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf fixed only in 7.1.6; 7.0.0's sole change is iteration-safe insertion, and the app's full Tailwind CSS output is byte-identical under 7.1.6 — drop when migrating to tailwindcss@4). The real fix for each is upgrading the owning dep. (3) Deferred (2026-10-04): GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm (braces <=3.0.3, high, stack-exhaustion DoS) has NO patched release — 3.0.3 is latest. Reachable only via frontend devDeps at lint/build time on developer-authored globs (eslint-config-next → @next/eslint-plugin-next → fast-glob → micromatch, and tailwindcss@3 → chokidar/fast-glob); eslint-config-next@16 still pulls it, so no upgrade clears it. Remove from ignoreGhsas as soon as braces ships a fix (then refresh the lockfile). Nothing else is suppressed. (@sentry/nextjs v10 also moved OpenTelemetry to 2.x, clearing the previously-deferred @opentelemetry/core GHSA-8988 medium.)
